sentences.japanese: 温泉はあなたに効くでしょう。
sentences.english: The hot spring will do you good.

sentences.japanese: 医者はこの病気に効く薬を探している。
sentences.english: The doctor is looking for medicine that is effective for this illness.

sentences.japanese: ブレーキが効かなかった。
その薬は彼の体に驚くほどよく効いた。
sentences.english: The medicine did wonders for his health.

sentences.japanese: その薬は彼に不思議なほどよく効いた。
sentences.english: The medicine had a wonderful effect on him.
